design_doc: A first-person tactical shooter in UE5. Player is a counter-terrorism operative in tactical gear clearing an abandoned prison. Weapon is a generated pump-action shotgun (one hand on pistol grip, one on foregrip). Enemies are terrorists in all black with rifle, shoot and death animations. Scene uses imported open-source prison map. Win by eliminating all enemies. 5 enemy motion clips (idle/walk/shoot/hit_react/death) and 3 player hand motion clips (idle/shoot/reload) generated via MoMask.
